# Game Idea: Neon Runner

- **Genre:** Endless runner / arcade
- **Core mechanic:** Player steers a neon ship through a scrolling grid, collecting energy orbs and dodging moving barriers.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with any barrier or timer reaching zero ends the game.
- **Goal:** Maximize score by collecting orbs and surviving as long as possible.

1: // Neon Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Sound assets (embedded as data URLs)
9:   const collectSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short beep
10:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short beep (replace with different tone if desired)
11:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // looped background (placeholder)
12:   bgMusic.loop = true;
13:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
14:   bgMusic.play();
15: 
16:   // Full‑screen canvas
17:   const resize = () => {
18:     // generate stars for background (once per resize)
19:     stars = [];
20:     const starCount = Math.min(200, Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height / 8000));
21:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
22:       stars.push({
23:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
24:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
25:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
26:       });
27:     }
28:     // gradient background
29:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
30:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
31:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
32:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
33:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
34:   };
35:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
36:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
37:   };
38:   resize();
39:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
40: 
41:   // Game constants
42:   const SHIP_SIZE = 30;
43:   const ORB_SIZE = 12;
44:   const BARRIER_WIDTH = 40;
45:   const BARRIER_HEIGHT = 120;
46:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
47:   const ORB_INTERVAL = 2000;
48:   const SPEED = 5;
49:   const GAME_TIME = 60; // seconds
50: 
51:   // State
52:   const ship = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - SHIP_SIZE * 2, w: SHIP_SIZE, h: SHIP_SIZE };
53:   let obstacles = [];
54:   let orbs = [];
55:   let stars = [];
56:   let score = 0;
57:   let timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
58:   let lastSpawn = 0;
59:   let lastOrb = 0;
60:   let lastTick = performance.now();
61:   let gameOver = false;
62: 
63:   // Input handling
64:   const keys = {};
65:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
66:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
67: 
68:   const rectCollision = (a, b) =>
69:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
70: 
71:   const spawnBarrier = () => {
72:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - BARRIER_WIDTH);
73:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -BARRIER_HEIGHT, w: BARRIER_WIDTH, h: BARRIER_HEIGHT });
74:   };
75: 
76:   const spawnOrb = () => {
77:     const size = ORB_SIZE;
78:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
79:     const y = -size;
80:     orbs.push({ x, y, w: size, h: size });
81:   };
82: 
83:   const update = (now) => {
84:     const dt = now - lastTick;
85:     lastTick = now;
86:     if (gameOver) return;
87: 
88:     // timer
89:     timeLeft -= dt / 1000;
90:     if (timeLeft <= 0) {
91:       timeLeft = 0;
92:       gameOver = true;
93:     }
94: 
95:     // move ship
96:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= SPEED;
97:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += SPEED;
98:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= SPEED;
99:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += SPEED;
100:     // keep inside canvas
101:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
102:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
103: 
104:     // spawn entities
105:     if (now - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
106:       spawnBarrier();
107:       lastSpawn = now;
108:     }
109:     if (now - lastOrb > ORB_INTERVAL) {
110:       spawnOrb();
111:       lastOrb = now;
112:     }
113: 
114:     // update obstacles/orbs
115:     const moveY = SPEED * (dt / 16);
116:     obstacles.forEach(o => (o.y += moveY));
117:     orbs.forEach(o => (o.y += moveY * 0.8));
118: 
119:     // collision detection
120:     for (const o of obstacles) {
121:       if (rectCollision(ship, o)) {
122:         gameOver = true;
123:         crashSound.play();
124:         break;
125:       }
126:     }
127:     if (!gameOver) {
128:       // collect orbs
129:       orbs = orbs.filter(orb => {
130:         if (rectCollision(ship, orb)) {
131:           score += 10;
132:           collectSound.currentTime = 0;
133:           collectSound.play();
134:           return false;
135:         }
136:         // remove off‑screen
137:         return orb.y < canvas.height;
138:       });
139:     }
140:     // remove passed obstacles
141:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.y < canvas.height);
142: 
143:     draw();
144:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
145:     else drawGameOver();
146:   };
147: 
148: const draw = () => {
149:     // Clear and draw background gradient
150:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
151:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
152:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
153:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
154:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
156: 
157:     // draw stars
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     stars.forEach(s => {
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     });
164: 
165:     // neon background grid
166:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
167:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
168:     for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
171:       ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
172:       ctx.stroke();
173:     }
174:     for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 40) {
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
177:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
178:       ctx.stroke();
179:     }
180: 
181:     // ship – neon triangle
182:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
183:     ctx.beginPath();
184:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
185:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
186:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
187:     ctx.closePath();
188:     ctx.fill();
189: 
190:     // barriers – neon rectangles
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
192:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
193:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
194:     });
195: 
196:     // orbs – neon circles
197:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
198:     orbs.forEach(o => {
199:       ctx.beginPath();
200:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
201:       ctx.fill();
202:     });
203: 
204:     // UI
205:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
206:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
207:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
208:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}`, 20, 60);
209:   };
210: 
211:   const drawGameOver = () => {
212:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
213:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
214:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
215:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
216:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
217:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
218:     ctx.font = '32px monospace';
219:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
220:   };
221: 
222:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
223: })();

(End of file - total 223 lines)
</content>
